unify.summary: Hands-on with a research identity on Unify's free Pro trial. We did not connect a mailbox, CRM, phone or card, so outreach was not sent.
findings: Onboarding requires connecting Gmail or Outlook, with no skip button. The dashboard was still reachable afterwards.
Everything is driven by an AI chat (Create / Build with chat, scheduled chats). There is no separate Agents product or AI surcharge.
Pro trial is $0/month with 500 plan credits, ending Nov 1, 2026. Inviting a teammate earns 100 credits.

Contact data is a waterfall over third-party providers (Universal Data, Wiza, ContactOut, Findymail, Prospeo, FullEnrich, Forager). An email costs 1-6 credits and a phone 4-15 credits, from one shared pool.
Daily sending caps: 50 sequenced, 50 manual emails, 50 automatic emails, 100 dials and only 10 LinkedIn touches. LinkedIn is the bottleneck.
Targeting is account-first: companies get a Low / Medium / High intent label from imports, signals or CRM sync. We saw no relationship graph comparable to LinkedIn's warm-path view.
